Evaluate each named criterion independently
against its extracted value and the complete arguments of this SAME tool call.
Return one Boolean verdict and a concise evidence-based reason per check_id.
Do not combine criteria into a holistic score or add requirements.

Use the request and same-call arguments to resolve names, pronouns, abbreviations,
and intended authorship. Accept equivalent wording that communicates the required
meaning. A first-person document written for the requesting user can refer to
that user as I; do not demand repetition of a name when authorship is clear.
The request and criteria are not evidence that the action included an answer.
Missing, incomplete, ambiguous, contradictory, or negated REQUIRED meaning fails.
Do not confuse mentioning a forbidden claim in an explicit denial with making
that claim. Do not obtain missing content from another call or criterion.

Return only JSON: {"results": [{"check_id": "supplied ID", "passed": true,
"reason": "exact supporting text or missing requirement"}]}.
Include every supplied check_id exactly once and no additional IDs.

{"user_request": "Create a compact lifecycle-design checklist for future Helio Start touches. Before reviewers approve copy or automation, require them to record the approved lifecycle-fork choice and the approved decision on wholesale reuse of the retained-mid onboarding and lifecycle path. State the approved answers; do not leave either item as an open choice.", "today": "2028-01-01", "tool": "create_doc", "arguments": {"title": "Helio Start lifecycle-design checklist — future touches", "folder": "Growth", "body": "Purpose
Keep future Helio Start lifecycle work conservative, reviewable, and separate from retained-mid assumptions.

Before approving any copy or automation, reviewers must record:

- Lifecycle-fork choice — APPROVED ANSWER: Keep the initial Helio Start fork conservative. Do not rewrite or reuse the whole lifecycle program at once. Fork where the path depends on simple self-serve setup, permissions, imports, billing, admin ownership, eligibility, or support routing.
- Wholesale reuse of the retained-mid onboarding and lifecycle path — APPROVED ANSWER: NO. Do not reuse it wholesale. Adapt only individual touches after checking that their assumptions fit Helio Start; remove or isolate multi-admin invite assumptions, presumed integration-owner permissions, premature upgrade/team-use language, and unsupported live-CS, billing, migration, or import-help promises.

Approval gate
- Copy/automation owner records both approved answers above in the review record.
- Confirm the touch has a supported trigger, audience, eligibility state, and destination.
- Keep state-changing touches under heavier QA; lighter review is acceptable only for mapping and non-state-changing education.
- Do not automate refusal, billing-mismatch, import-stuck, or support-handoff branches unless eligibility and support boundaries are explicitly approved.
- Record owner, evidence, suppression rules, fallback/routing behavior, and rollback before activation.

No approval if either decision is omitted, rewritten as an open choice, or contradicted by the proposed touch."}, "checks": [{"check_id": "riley_012_01", "path": "args", "criterion": "The body is a compact, actionable lifecycle-design checklist for future Helio Start touches rather than an essay. Before copy or automation can be approved, it must require reviewers to confirm a conservative Helio Start-specific lifecycle fork and explicitly disallow wholesale borrowing of the retained-mid onboarding or lifecycle path. Equivalent wording and checklist formats are acceptable.", "value": {"title": "Helio Start lifecycle-design checklist — future touches", "folder": "Growth", "body": "Purpose
Keep future Helio Start lifecycle work conservative, reviewable, and separate from retained-mid assumptions.

Before approving any copy or automation, reviewers must record:

- Lifecycle-fork choice — APPROVED ANSWER: Keep the initial Helio Start fork conservative. Do not rewrite or reuse the whole lifecycle program at once. Fork where the path depends on simple self-serve setup, permissions, imports, billing, admin ownership, eligibility, or support routing.
- Wholesale reuse of the retained-mid onboarding and lifecycle path — APPROVED ANSWER: NO. Do not reuse it wholesale. Adapt only individual touches after checking that their assumptions fit Helio Start; remove or isolate multi-admin invite assumptions, presumed integration-owner permissions, premature upgrade/team-use language, and unsupported live-CS, billing, migration, or import-help promises.

Approval gate
- Copy/automation owner records both approved answers above in the review record.
- Confirm the touch has a supported trigger, audience, eligibility state, and destination.
- Keep state-changing touches under heavier QA; lighter review is acceptable only for mapping and non-state-changing education.
- Do not automate refusal, billing-mismatch, import-stuck, or support-handoff branches unless eligibility and support boundaries are explicitly approved.
- Record owner, evidence, suppression rules, fallback/routing behavior, and rollback before activation.

No approval if either decision is omitted, rewritten as an open choice, or contradicted by the proposed touch."}}]}
